project_info.theme: Warm mirror beauty fashion editorial with deep-red accents
project_info.color_palette: warm neutral cream, deep red, dark hair, natural skin tones

main_subject.type: adult woman using a required approved-adult face reference
main_subject.detail: One adult woman whose face, facial structure, natural asymmetries, proportions, eye shape and distance, nose, lips, jawline, cheekbones, and visible skin details match the attached approved-adult face reference. She has dark hair in an elegant updo with loose tendrils and one subtle wet-look strand across the forehead, soft smoky eyes, defined brows, subtle blush, luminous natural skin, and bold deep-red lipstick. She smiles genuinely with slightly visible teeth and joyful eyes while holding a small cluster of red cherries. She wears a structured deep-red corset-style top.
main_subject.style: cinematic photorealistic indoor beauty and fashion editorial with natural skin texture

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 4:5 photoreal indoor mirror beauty-fashion editorial. Use the attached approved-adult face reference for one adult woman and preserve her face, facial structure, proportions, eye shape and distance, nose shape, lip shape, jawline, cheekbones, visible moles, freckles, scars, natural asymmetries, and skin texture; do not blend identities, beautify, or age-shift. In a minimal neutral-toned room, place a mirror behind her showing the back of her dark elegant updo and deep-red corset-style top. Keep a few loose tendrils framing her face and one subtle editorial wet-look strand across her forehead. Give her soft smoky eyes, defined brows, subtle blush, luminous natural skin, bold deep-red lipstick, and a genuine warm smile with slightly visible teeth and joyful eyes. She holds a small cluster of red cherries near her shoulder. Preserve the attached style reference's pose, composition, warm palette, lighting, and vibe. Use soft warm indoor light around 3400K with gentle mirror bounce, cinematic photoreal detail, subtle 35mm grain, natural dynamic range, and real unretouched skin. No nudity, explicit sexual content, logos, watermark, or readable text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, nudity, identity blending, celebrity likeness, age shift, facial beautification, symmetry correction, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, logo, watermark, readable text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach two required assets: (1) an approved-adult face/identity reference and (2) a style/composition reference. Preserve the person's face, facial structure, and likeness exactly from the approved-adult reference, without celebrity/public-figure substitution. Preserve pose, mirror composition, warm neutral palette, lighting, red corset-style outfit, updo, cherries, and editorial vibe from the style reference. Background may change only if the mirror relationship and neutral luxury setting remain intact.

assets.name: approved-adult-face-identity-reference
assets.usage: Keep the adult face, facial structure, likeness, natural asymmetries, skin details, and proportions consistent; do not blend identities or use a celebrity/public-figure likeness.

assets.name: mirror-red-lip-style-composition-reference
assets.usage: Preserve the mirror composition, pose, warm palette, lighting, deep-red styling, cherries, and luxury beauty-editorial mood while not altering the face identity.
